title: User Annotations Schema & API
completion_summary: User annotations schema, queries, and API routes implemented
acceptance_criteria: WatchStatus enum: WATCHED, WATCHING, WANT_TO_WATCH, DROPPED
UserAnnotation model with: userId (default 'local'), entityType (MOVIE/TV/PERSON), entityId (TMDB ID), watchStatus, personalRating (1-10 nullable), notes (text), watchDate (datetime nullable)
Watchlist model with: name, description, createdAt
WatchlistItem model linking Watchlist to media entities
API validates personalRating is 1-10 or null
API validates watchStatus is valid enum value
All text uses i18n translation keys
